name: expinv
expr: x_default = expinv(ps); x_mu2 = expinv(ps, 2); x_mu5 = expinv(0.5, 5); x_p0 = expinv(0.0, 1); x_p1 = expinv(1.0, 1); x_pneg = expinv(-0.1, 1); x_pover = expinv(1.5, 1); x_mubad = expinv(0.5, 0); x_muneg = expinv(0.5, -1);
comment: Sig: x = expinv(p[, mu]). Inverse exponential CDF: x = -mu*log(1-p). Default mu=1. Covers default form + non-default mu + boundaries (p=0,1) + invalid (p<0, p>1, mu<=0).
